listing_name: Basement: Mountainside Private Room & Private Bath
comments:
Thanks, Peter and Alison for opening up your basement!

The listing is accurate-- it is a finished, but basic basement apartment. If you're looking for a functional place to crash for a great deal, with proximity to Asheville and the Biltmore estate, this is the place (picture staying with a friend at college, as long as that college is UNC-- we loved the basketball memorabilia everywhere!).

The private entrance is great, and convenient. We never saw the hosts, but this was not a problem at all. Two caveats (didn't bother us, but might others)-- there is not a way to lock the door, as it is left unlocked by the owners. It's in a seemingly very safe neighborhood though. Also, there are no curtains or blinds-- again, someone would probably have to come up on the porch to see in, and thankfully the house faces West, so we didn't have a problem with the sunrise.

Other than that, the apartment is great, exactly as advertised.

Brady was easy to communicate with and check in was very simple. The apartment is very clean and has some nice touches like an assortment of coffees and extra condiments in the fridge. There are also beverages (wine, beer, sparkling waters) and snacks available for a very small fee. The shower is very nice but the bathroom is quite small. There is a separate living room so the place is spacious enough but has very little natural light as it is a walkout basement apartment. It is easy to get to locations in Asheville from there.

Brady's space and location are absolutely phenomenal. The space was tidy and accommodating and you cannot beat the location to downtown and the area. We were able to walk and get food and refreshments as well as take a short 7 minute drive to virtually anywhere downtown!
Large and spacious basement apartment in amazing location. Convenient to everything in Asheville. Very afford and private, exactly the getaway we needed. Would definitely use again.

Our decision to stay at Brady’s for a night as we passed through Asheville was super last minute and I was impressed with how quickly he responded and accepted our request. He even had the space ready for us several hours before check-in time. The space was clean, comfortable, and organized, and the bed was the absolute most comfortable bed I’ve ever slept in! Upon lying down I almost gave up on exploring Asheville altogether, I could have stayed in that bed forever. Overall a lovely stay and very satisfying for the low price! Great location too. Thanks Brady!
Space was as described, cozy, easy self check-in.  Great free coffee bar.  Snacks and local beers at cost on the honor system was a nice convenience.
Great deal and location! Big, clean apartment with lots of privacy.
This was a great location, super close to downtown. The complimentary coffee bar and honor system beer bar were nice touches.
It worked for what we needed. Close to downtown and it was very private.
Spacious place in a really fantastic location. There are 2 rooms and a pretty big kitchen. There are many restaurants in walking distance and downtown is around 10 minutes away. Highly recommend!
Perfect place for a weekend getaway. Close to several restaurants. Lots of extra touches that make it feel very homely.
Great location and amenities for the price. The years that Brady has been renting on Airbnb truly shows in his hospitality and professionalism.
Had the best stay here, lovely amenities, great location!  Ask for the tour!
Great location only a short walk away from yummy food and ice cream! We liked the private entrance and quiet neighborhood.
The place was super clean and cozy. Brady was very helpful and friendly and I would definitely recommend to visit if you like being close to downtown

This was a perfect stay on all accounts. Brady has thought about all details that make for a comfortable stay, including toiletries and convenient snacks/drinks you can leave cash for. The location is wonderful and check in/out was easy! I would happily return.
My husband and I had a wonderful stay! The location is fantastic and Brady and Cassie really go out of their way to make their guests comfortable.
Super cozy and close to everything. For the price, you can’t beat it.
A nice place to stay. It is affordable and comfortable. A great location. I would stay there again and I would recommend it to others.

What a perfect place after a fun day in Asheville. Driveway is flat and right by the door to enter the apartment. Everything you might need is there  I love the extra touches that can be found in every room that make you feel like you are staying with friends! We will most certainly be back!
I enjoyed my stay while there.
Awesome stay super convenient location and Brady was an awesome host. He made sure we were comfortable and happy. I highly recommend this stay.
Staying at this location during my road trip was a delightful breeze. The communication, check in process, and amenities was so smooth and simple. Would definitely rent again when i’m in town
Excellent location, easily accessible, and comfortable lodgings. Brady made the check in so easy!
Restful stay close to downtown Asheville. Everything was a described!
This place exceeds expectations in every sense! The hosts, as well! They went above and beyond to accommodate me and I could not be more thankful!

Great location to downtown and a short Uber ride to everything in addition to places close enough to walk.
The area felt safe and the separate entrance and driveway were perfect! Bed was comfortable and the water pressure was strong 👍

We had a delightful stay in Brady's home. It's in a great location with good food and entertainment in walking distance. It's also within a very short drive of the River Arts district, walking trails along the French Broad River and the Biltmore. The apartment was very clean and had everything you need and probably all you'd want for a visit to beautiful Asheville. We'd definitely stay there again.
Great spot, cozy, quiet, close to all the things and feels like your in a cabin. Loved it.

Brady’s stay was extremely convenient in terms of location! So close to our concert venue and dinner locations! The space was quiet as it states in the overview and tidy! They had board games, a Roku tv and a stocked fridge at low cost for our convenience! It was great for a one night weekend stay, would’ve liked to stay longer!

Brady's place met our needs for an overnight stay. The apartment is clean, but nothing fancy and slightly dated. Both the queen bed and set-up queen air mattress were very comfortable.
Brady was very communicative and one of the most accommodating hosts I have experienced. He was very flexible for both our check-in and check-out.
Brady’s place was a great spot to land after a long day of travel. So nice to find beers to purchase in the fridge so I really didn’t have to go out at all. Worth the stay and would stay again

This basement apartment is clean, comfortable, and has everything you could need. It’s a 10 minute drive to downtown or west Asheville, conveniently located and in a safe area. The water pressure in the shower is fantastic and Brady provides a useful town guide in a binder for tips on places to check out locally. I would definitely stay there again!
It was a great cozy place and so easy to get down town too. Had and amazing stay can’t wait to come back!
Great place and location. Very comfortable place and warm as well (it was freezing cold during my stay in Asheville).
My friend and I were in town for a quick visit to see a concert in town. Brady’s place had everything we needed, check in and out was easy, and the neighborhood was so cute!

I felt safe and comfortable as a solo female traveler. PERFECT location! Convenient to anything you’d want to do in the Asheville area. Minutes to
Downtown. Cozy spot to stay, huge kitchen! All areas are large and feel like home. You can tell the hosts care about sharing their space and put a lot of thought into the details. I’ll definitely book again when I’m in the area. Cheers!

Great place, highly recommend! Currently appears to be working on  several upgrades to make it even nicer. Fully stocked kitchen including drinks for purchase if you want and a guide book with good local recommendations from restaurants, breweries, and hikes.
Brady was a great host! Can’t beat the price for a place with such ease of walkability in the area and a sauna!
Very clean, perfect location. Great communication and easy getting to the location and getting into the apartment

The apartment was neat as a pin, quiet, yet so close we could walk to about anything we needed or wanted to do.  The Sauna is a definite added benefit that I enjoyed each evening.  The Apartment not only has everything - it has many extras - like a sound machine that let me fall asleep fast and stay asleep.  The bed was extremely comfortable with above standard linens.
Great place, convenient and walkable to several restaurants. Easy drive to downtown for more eats and shopping. We had a great stay and look forward to visiting again.
Spacious, clean apartment with full kitchen, great mattress, sauna and shower water pressure.  Suited our needs well.  Nearby restaurant, the Green Sage, was excellent.
Brady’s space was a great place to spend a stress-free weekend in Asheville.

Brady's place is second to none.
The king bed, pillows and comforter were so comfortable. Kitchen had EVERYTHING you could ever need.
You won't find a better location with all the comforts Brady provided, anyway.
Thanks Brady
Great place to stay in Asheville. Walking distance to food/shopping. Easy drive to Blue ridge parkway. Comfortable bed and linens. Loved the sauna and coffee bar in the am.

Cute place, newly renovated with a full sized eat in kitchen. The bedroom is very comfy and I liked the decor.
The hosts have an honor bar with local craft beer, and I enjoyed the opportunity to try something new at the end of a long day.
Many airbnbs in Asheville require you to walk a steep slope with your suitcase and this one has parking steps away from your private entrance, which I liked.
Great location, near some good restaurants, close to downtown, but not in downtown.
Everything was great and as listed. I wish we could have made time for a massage!

Loved the apartment and bed was really comfortable. It's nice to have a full kitchen!  And olive oil and spices.  Some folks talked about footsteps upstairs.  I am really sensitive to that but with our noise machine it seemed mild.  I was only there two nights but I don't think it started before 7:00.  And it is typical with basement apartments.  Great place!
Really enjoyed my stay especially the sauna! Great location and close to everything Asheville has to offer.
Brady was an excellent host! Checked in on me while I was there. I loved the place especially the sauna! I would definitely stay there again!  Thank you, Brady!
Perfect place!  Everything you need for comfort!!

Brady’s space was perfect for a weekend getaway! The location is great, the apartment spacious, and he was very responsive and friendly. I would definitely consider booking this space again for another stay in Asheville!
We loved staying at this Airbnb. It was clean and bigger than we were expecting. It was also very quiet which I loved!  It was close to so many places. I would definitely recommend this Airbnb.
This was a perfect little getaway for a quick overnight stay. Thank you for the clear instructions and spotless place. Will def be back!

This place was the perfect spot if you’re looking just for a place to crash at night. Easy to find, quick to a lot of places. Not much to do at the actual airbnb which is okay because there are so many things to do around. You can hear the footsteps from upstairs but it’s only from 7am-9pm. I brought headphones so it was fine. Worth the money for a nice kitchen and sauna! The sauna gets very hot which was great. Thanks Brady!
Very relaxing stay with great ammentities! Would stay again!
Loved it! Located centrally near everything yet very peaceful and private. It was easy to locate, get in and get out. Clean space, well organized and decorated. Will return when needed.

So good! Christal was communicative from pre-booking to check out. Gave amazing recommendations for restaurants, keeps a beautiful and quiet home, and very laid back. The apartment had everything you could need, and one of the most comfortable bed/pillow situations imaginable. Also, parking is plentiful and convenient.

Our stay was great. Christal was very inviting and the property was exactly what we were hoping for. It is located so close to a great little coffee shop and other shopping. Downtown is about two minutes away, and the Biltmore is about ten minutes. I highly recommend this property to anyone hoping for some privacy and relaxation.
Loved the place and the nighberhood. Every thing was as described cozy comfy place .. Thank you Christal.
We had a short, but enjoyable experience at Christal's place! The bed was comfy and the atmosphere was calm and pleasant. I would recommend this place to anyone!

Wonderful place to stay!! Christal's place was adorable and conveniently located to shopping, restaurants and so many great breweries. Between her great recommendations and her quick response time Christal was an excellent host. Highly recommend this spot! Of all the places I have stayed at this one was definitely my favorite. If I'm ever back in Asheville I would definitely stay here again!
Christal was welcoming we had everything we needed. A great time and easy walk to downtown!

This was one of our best Airbnb experiences. The place was clean, wonderfully decorated, centrally located, and just a delightful and warm space. We had a fantastic time relaxing there. The couch and bed were both comfortable, and the bathroom was wonderful. The little kitchen allowed us to make our own breakfast and a quick cuppa. Positively thrilled with the whole experience and would 100% recommend it to anyone!

This was a really sweet and comfortable spot to relax after a long work trip with friends. We didn't have a car so it was a convenient location for us to walk into downtown for food and drinks. It takes about 20 minutes to walk into the heart of downtown, but coming from city living we don't mind walking. If you wanted to really explore the area I would recommend renting a car. Christal gave us our privacy but if we needed anything at all she was very prompt to replying. Definitely recommend it if you are easy going.

This cozy apartment in the back of Christal's home is a perfect spot to stay while visiting Asheville. A quick walk to downtown, a block from high five (delicious local coffee spot) and a block from whole foods! Would highly recommend.
Enjoyed our two day stay in Asheville at Christal's! Very nice place, plenty of room, and a great location. Definitely check out High Five Coffee that is just a few minutes away.

Crystal's place feels ever roomier than the photos. Check in was very simple - we were out exploring minutes after pulling into town. Everything you could need was provided. The bed was extremely comfortable. Location was super walkable to everything downtown.
Wonderful hideaway-incredibly clean comfortable and very nicely designed. I wish I could've stayed longer!

The place was so cute and located really close to downtown. It was the perfect spot to get to our favorite restaurants on Merrimon and to access the spots we love in the downtown area. The house was  very neat and cozy, and we loved the decor and the ambience. The little kitchen was very well equipped,  and although the apartment is part of the main house it was very quiet next door.  The only major issue was a really bright security light at the neighboring house that kept going on and off all through the night and illuminating the bedroom.

Christal's charming little get-away is well appointed, full of character and just steps from shopping, restaurants and yoga! If you are looking for an Asheville experience and want to be in the middle of it's local culture - Christal's place is a must stay!

My boyfriend and I spent out first night in Asheville at Christal's place and absolutely loved it! This place was super close to some great breweries and restaurants we wanted to check out. Christal was a very hands-off host but was timely and responsive anytime we needed help. We're looking forward to staying in her charming studio again in the future!

This was our first experience staying in an Airbnb and it was great! Christal was a great host and her place was perfect and exactly like the pictures! We were close to everything (breweries, shops, restaurants) and we walked everywhere the whole weekend. The weather was just what we hoped for...we definitely will be back! I will stay at Christal's place moving forward - it was super clean, comfortable, and adorable. We can't wait to be back for a trip in the summer! Thank you, Christal!

Christal's studio was conveniently located to downtown and near the best coffee shop, High Five. I thoroughly enjoyed my stay and will recommend this space to others who are traveling to Asheville. Thank you!

I was in town for a conference at the Marriott, but I don't like staying at conference hotels so I booked Christals instead...great decision! Walking distance to many breweries and restaurants (and the conference) also grocery stores. The place itself is very homey and comfortable, on a quiet residential block. Highly recommend! Ps just down the street from the Moog Store which has awesome free tours if you are a music nerd like me 🤗

If you are looking for a warm, cosy location, close to downtown, markets and on-ramps but far enough removed for peace and quiet, DEFINITELY check out Christal's gorgeous place.
Inviting, homey and well furnished, this adorable pad is perfectly located and will charm you as much as Asheville itself.
Our first choice for any future visits to the area!
This was a lovely little place! Would recommend this place to others for sure!
Christal's house was the perfect, cozy retreat!  Great location in downtown Asheville makes it easy to explore.  Quiet, charming, clean and relaxing.
The apartment was great! We loved our stay!
Perfect setup for our first trip to Asheville! Highly recommend for couples or individuals. Ideal location, easy access, and clear communication throughout. Hope to be back soon! Thanks Christal!
Great location and a very nice place, I would advise anyone to stay there.
Christal's place is so charming, comfortable, clean and well located to enjoying what Asheville has to offer. Highly recommend!

The rental space is about a 1/2 mile from everything downtown. The decor is warm and inviting. The furniture is very comfortable. Super clean and had a pleasant and calming aroma.  Totally exceeded my expectations.

This is THE place to stay in Asheville. So close to downtown, we walked every where. Adorable living space, clean, fresh, comfortable. Private entrance and street parking made our getaway super easy. Cristal was extremely hospitable. We were so happy with our stay.

Cristal was great. The space was clean, comfortable and in such a great location.  Cristal was communicative,  flexible, and had me feel welcome.  There are so many great things to do and great places to eat in the neighborhood.
Walkable to downtown with lots of food and brewery options. The space is clean and comfortable. Christal was easy to communicate with and we really enjoyed our stay!
Awesome place that is close to everything in downtown ashville. Spend two nights and was able to walk everywhere we wanted to go. Great host, great place to stay!

We loved our stay at Christal’s place. Very charming space, and it had everything we needed. Right next to a grocery store, and pretty close to all the shopping and restaurants. Everything was clean and ready to go. Thank you so much!
Cozy and charming- this place has it all. About a 5-10minute walk to downtown. We highly recommend eating at Zambra! Asheville was a wonderful vacation.
We loved our stay here! Nice place and great location in Asheville!

Great location.  Whole foods is a block away.  Free parking spot in front.  There was tea and coffee available.  Nice toiletries.   Crystal is very fast to reply.  She lives upstairs and easy to get in touch with.   Recommended place.

What a picture-perfect gem of an Airbnb. Not only was I lucky enough to meet Christal (who is such a sweet soul), but I was fortunate to stay in this adorable, happy, homey space for a few days. I never wanted to leave. From the comfy cozy bed to the eclectic decor, this little place spoke to my vintage charm-loving heart. It is within walking distance to downtown Asheville, right across the street from a fabulous Whole Foods, and up the road from my new favorite coffee spot - High Five (try their oat milk latte!). If you're looking for a peaceful retreat steps from the city, you found it... beautiful art & a sense of home included.
Great place for an Asheville trip!

The apartment is cute and cozy, and the location is fantastic. But it was unclear to me when I booked the place for my wife's bday weekend that the apartment is really one side of Christal's home and that the walls are quite thin. My wife and I woke up to the sound of her dogs barking during a nap. At one point, the music from the other side of the house was loud and the bass was thumping in our room. (Something that I admit to be a little overly sensitive about.) Christal does provide a sound machine, but there is a limit to what that can do.
To be clear: we had a great time in Asheville and noise was never a major issue -- we slept fine both nights. But I wish I had been more aware of the house set up and the thin walls before I booked.
Great place. Really nice location!
Christal’s place was so lovely - we only wish we had more time to stay and enjoy it! It was perfect.

This place was absolutely beautiful. Very convenient location to downtown and within walking distance of a coffee shop, brewery, and whole foods. Each of which were nicely far away from many of the crowds in downtown at peak hours. Will absolutely book again next time I'm in the area.
Stayed in a lot of places in Asheville and this may be my favorite.

Christal's apartment was the perfect place for our weekend in Asheville. The apartment is incredibly charming with all the thoughtful touches. Parking was very easy, and we were just steps away from a very cute coffee shop and even a brewery. I would recommend this adorable apartment to any couple looking for a relaxing weekend in Asheville!

Christal’s place is great! We stayed for 3 nights and had a great time. The place is super clean and extremely stylish! The little back deck and backyard were really nice and I appreciated the thoughtful touches like coffee and tea being provided. The location is also excellent. We were within walking distance of everything downtown, and within 0.3 miles of Whole Foods, Trader Joe’s and Harris Teeter grocery stores! I would definitely stay here again.
Very cute place with a comfy bed and beautiful artwork. Had a wonderful trip to Asheville-the home is very close to downtown and in a cute neighborhood.

Christal’s romantic and bohemian private studio exceeded all of our expectations. The place was very clean and she provided everything we could need and more. Stylish living space and comfortable bed! Noise was no problem & she even included an optional sound machine. Also great location, very close to downtown! 10/10 would stay again.

This place was clean, spacious and had great amenities! Walking distance to downtown which was extremely convenient! The bed was so comfortable and the room was quiet, private and decorated beautifully. Would definitely stay again on my next visit to this awesome city!

We really enjoyed our stay in Asheville. The location was really great, and the place was very clean. I was a bit disappointed there didn't seem to be a way to adjust the temperature in the unit (I think it's controlled from the main house), as it got a bit warm inside and we didn't have a way to turn down the heat. Would stay again.
This was a wonderful, stylish space. Quiet, safe neighborhood, close to downtown, clean, and easy check-in.  Great place to stay!

The place, the decorations, and furnishings all feel amazing! It is quaint, aesthetic, truly Bohemian. Lighting and touches are all very well thought-out and cared for. There is a Whole Foods and Trader Joe's at <5 minutes walk.
My only issue was that the bathtub water wouldn't create a hot bath. It was somewhat lukewarm (though the shower was plenty hot). I so wanted to take a bath I ended up boiling extra kettles of water to supplement the bath... which was a big hassle.
Other than that, no issues. It's a very homey space with a large, spacious, green backyard that I appreciated. Thank you for your care Christal!

Christal’s place was a dream! The second you walk in, you can feel the charm. Super clean!!! The bed and sound machine provided one of the best night’s sleeps I’ve had in a long time!! We will be back!

This place is so cute. I would love to have stayed a few more nights. Great walking distance to lots of fun shops and great food. Christal has put a lot of thought and warmth into this place, and it shows.
Very convenient location for visiting Asheville at a fair price. Extremely clean.

Lovely stay! Cute place, very comfy bed, great location. About a 5 minute walk to downtown and extremely close to grocery stores and in-town nature walks. Nice kitchenette for cooking breakfast or storing take-out beer. We enjoyed it!
Christal is a great communicator and is dedicated to your comfort as a host. You can expect fair and kind treatment as her guest.
Great place for a couple to visit Asheville
This is a great deal on the cutest place that's just a short walk from downtown Asheville. This place and all the pieces Christal has curated for it are gorgeous. We loved staying here.

Cute space! Perfect for 2 people, has everything you would need. Great location close to downtown Asheville. We had a lovely stay here and would certainly re-book if returning to the area. Definitely recommend!!

Christals space is perfect to stay near downtown Asheville. It was easy check in / communication, and the location itself is very convenient and walkable to the main downtown area. Also loved the decor and space. Will definitely be recommending to friends in town!
Great location, super clean, space was beautiful and comfy. Perfect for an weekend Asheville getaway!

This Airbnb has a lot of personal touches which makes it a wonderful experience. The colors in the bedroom are very calming, the bathroom is perfectly designed with Asheville in mind and the art work around the house is very interesting. It was easy to walk downtown or grab an Uber if we wanted to go somewhere else. Parking was easy, too, with the parking pass.
awesome location, walking distance from two grocery stores and downtown.
Very artsy vibe. Quaint back of house and backyard location. Loved the mountains and the Blue Ridge Parkway.
Great little hippie bungalow close to downtown. Perfect for two guests!
We had a great weekend! The Airbnb was close to downtown, clean, and had everything we needed for my husband and myself. Would recommend and we would stay here again.
Lots of space and great location!

Christal’s place is perfect. If you’re like me and need to compare airbnbs before booking, save yourself the time and just book this one. Comfortable bed, great atmosphere/vibes, and close to everything. I will definitely try to stay here again the next time I come through!
Very clear move-in instructions and a nice space. A great location to explore Asheville and the mountains.

Christal’s place was amazing! We were about to walk to everything! This space was exactly what we needed for our weekend away. It looks like she may have another property in the same area we’d love to try next time! 5 stars all around!
Perfect location to be near downtown but away from noise.   Perfect for concerts at the Harrah's center!

If you have an opportunity to book this wonderful place, don't even hesitate, book it, it's that amazing!
when booking I thought it's ideal for romantic getaways but we had a blast there with my girlfriend and the bed was surprisingly enough and super-comfy. The main attraction of the place to me is the heart of it, since it's undoubtedly created by a true artist and you can feel it in every touch and in every detail. It's magic. I also stayed a part of the trip there alone due to the hurricane and I was perfectly happy being there pondering about life and times and discovering more and more of those little artistic details so lovingly and carefully placed there by Christal for you to enjoy. I also loved the back porch, having coffee there and enjoying the quiet and the nature there. Location is super convenient and you can avoid going under the bridge, there is another way, over another bridge. Food is a step away and downtown is a very short walk. Chrystal is very kind and caring, she was super accommodating and flexible during my stay. I can't say enough good words about that place. Thank you, Christal!
Amazing airbnb for so many reasons: very cute space, clean, accurate description, thoughtfully decorated, great location, etc etc. Everything was perfect.
awesome location, spacious unit with everything you need

Christal's place was adorable.  Artfully decorated and very welcoming.  It felt like home.  This place had everything we needed and was a perfect size and location for our stay.  I especially appreciated the fragrance-free environment and that there was a Whole Foods across the street to accommodate my special food needs.  It was absolutely perfect.  I hope to stay next time we visit Asheville.

This rental is adorable and comfortable - perfect for 2 people. We loved the location and neighborhood. The neighborhood is "turning," with some properties that have been renovated and others in the process or needing work. This didn't concern us, but some might be turned off or uncomfortable. We felt totally comfortable walking the area at night, and we found staff at the local restaurants and neighborhood bar to be friendly, welcoming and helpful. We would definitely stay again!
Of note: Christal's recommendations were spot on. We visited several of the establishments she recommended, and had a great experience every time.
A very quaint and cozy place to stay!

This was a really lovely find. The location was great: easy to find, walkable and a spot to park. I personally enjoyed the layout and decor inside the space, beautifully curated for a peaceful space. Lots of natural light, comfortable bed/linens, cozy seating and an outside bistro table where we enjoyed coffee in the morning!

This was a great place to stay for a long weekend in Asheville. The instructions for checking in were clear, and we had zero issues once we arrived. The apartment itself was cozy, comfortable, and had everything we needed. And the location made it super easy to walk everywhere and get around town. Thank you Christal!
We’ve stayed in both of Christal’s units. They’re warm, cozy, unique, and thoughtfully designed for guests - everything you’d want in an AirBnB.

Christal's place was perfect for our weekend in Asheville! Very cozy well decorated and fully equip apartment with all the little extras to ensure a comfortable stay. Location was walkable to downtown. Highly recommend Christal's place for a stay and would love to come back!

We had a great first visit to Asheville staying at Christal’s. You can’t beat the location—make sure to walk around the block to High Five Coffee—and the place itself was cozy and clean. Christal was especially helpful when we accidentally locked ourselves out… and was very quick to respond with help. We will definitely plan on staying here again whenever we return to Asheville!

Christal’s place was perfect!  Its location was perfect.  There were 2 grocery stores walking distance from her house and the place was walkable to some of the main eclectic streets and neighborhoods downtown.  Her place was cozy, artistic and nicely decorated.  She had all the things I needed while I was there for the weekend… just wish I could have stayed longer!
Perfect location for exploring the downtown area while also being quite and peaceful!
Christal's apartment was delightful. It was cozy and clean. We loved being able to walk to the downtown area. The neighborhood was quite. I highly recommend this apartment for an Ashville getaway.

Christal had the most comfortable bed in our 8 day trip!
Her place was super cute and well appointed.

Everything about this place is fabulous. It’s how airbnb used to be, with an owner who really cares and shares a unique experience with visitors.
The apartment is very comfortable, clean, and central to everything. It’s tucked away on a side street, so it has a quiet neighborhood feel.
The bed and linens are very soft. A lovely stay for one or two people.
Great place. Really nicely decorated and in a very convenient locations. Even had streaming services logged in.
I really enjoyed my stay here. The owner has great taste. Decor is a mix of vintage and modern. There is a Whole Foods 200-300 ft away. I would definitely return
I absolutely adored the place. Will return for leisure travel.
Wonderfully decorated comfy space with all of the convenience of downtown within walking distance. We had a great time

My husband and I spent our first wedding anniversary here. We had a great time in this space. It was private and cozy and we loved the art. We also greatly appreciated the host and the local recs she provided. Would definitely visit again.
Absolutely perfect! We were traveling and just needed a place to stop for a night. We wish we could’ve stayed longer!!

I can't say enough about this place!!! It was gorgeous and cozy and I wanted to stay forever. Whole foods is literally close enough to throw a ball in the parking lot and also Harris teeter and traders Joe's is walkable. I also walked and biked to other places. You can cook and warm up food. The bathroom had toiletries and Kleenex. Everything was clean and looked just like the photos. I will DEFINITELY be back.
Charming place, with lovely original art. Quiet.Easy walk to downtown. I was there to do some writing and explore the area. Perfect spot for solo traveler or a couple.
Christal's place was fantastic!! Definitely recommend, the location is perfect!
Christal’s place was so precious. We will absolutely stay there again on our next visit!
Great Airbnb! Super convenient location and walkable to downtown. Super cute inside and very clean!

We had a really comfortable weekend stay at Christal's place. The location was close to downtown Asheville and pretty walkable, but far away enough to be peaceful and quiet as well. The place itself was super cozy and comfortable with everything we needed for the trip away. Perfect spot from which to explore Asheville and then be able to come back to relax and unwind. Would love to stay again and highly recommend!

This place is fabulous! Super cute, well decorated, well equipped. Cozy with cute tiny patio - views to garden. Walkable distance to downtown.
And the most importantly, super clean! We willl absolutely stay again when we come back to Asheville.
Christal is kind, friendly, response, and helpful.
10+ for this stay.

We absolutely loved our stay at Christal's place! It immediately felt like home- cozy, comfortable, personalized, and beautifully decorated. You can tell that the owner has put a lot of thought into the details! The little back porch facing the garden is a dream, and gets beautiful light in the evenings. Parking was easy.
